lines.text: History's biggest video game leak was pulled off with a TV remote.
And the hacker was locked inside an English hotel room.
Seventeen-year-old Arion was arrested and had all his laptops seized.
Police put him on bail in a budget motel under strict monitoring.
With zero computers allowed, he bought an Amazon Fire Stick for forty dollars.
He plugged the stick into the hotel television and bypassed security.
Using just a keyboard and phone, he breached Rockstar Games' Slack.
He downloaded ninety unreleased gameplay clips of Grand Theft Auto Six.
Then leaked them online, completely shattering the internet and stock market.
A judge sentenced him indefinitely to a secure medical facility.
